title: Update landing hero tagline font and highlight “FREE” in orange

requirements.text: Update the marketing landing page hero headline “RIDE FREE. RIDE FAR.” (frontend/src/pages/LandingPage.tsx) so the headline uses the “Black Ops One” typeface, and ensure the word “FREE” renders in orange (the primary theme color) as a filled text color (not transparent/outline-only).

quotes:
change 

RIDEFREE.RIDE FAR. font to black ops one and free must be in orange

acceptanceCriteria: On route "/", the hero headline “RIDE FREE. RIDE FAR.” is rendered using the Black Ops One font.
The “FREE” word is clearly filled with the orange primary color (not transparent fill), while the rest of the headline styling remains readable and consistent with the current hero layout.
No other user-facing text is changed as part of this update.

constraints: Do not modify any files under frontend/src/components/ui (compose existing components instead).
Respect the existing Tailwind theme tokens (use the existing primary orange token for the “FREE” color).
nonGoals: Changing global typography settings (site-wide heading/body fonts).
Updating any logo/brand assets or other landing page sections beyond the specified hero headline styling.
